survey: A carved jack-o'-lantern sits on a wooden plank tabletop in front of a purple ray background. Pumpkin body: a wide, squat sphere with vertical ribs. The ribs curve around the body evenly and bunch up toward the left and right edges, which matches a round form seen from slightly above eye level. Stem: a green stalk rising from the top. Its cut end shows as a narrow ellipse, which fits the same slightly-high camera. Face: two triangular eyes and a zigzag mouth on the front of the body. The mouth bends with the curve of the body, and the carved inner walls show on the lower edges, which fits a camera a little above. Table: the planks run back toward a far edge high in the frame, so we look down on it gently. The plank lines run roughly parallel, converging slightly. Contact: the flattened base of the pumpkin rests on the planks. A soft shadow falls back and to the right, and the base curve matches the slightly-high view. The camera's height agrees across the stem, the body, the face and the table.
